description: A pill-shaped prompt input whose small side button cycles through prompt presets, each bringing its own icon and a word-by-word animated Persian placeholder; the arrow button and Enter hand the typed value over.
interactionNotes: Click the small circular button on the start side: the current icon blurs out and the next preset's icon blurs in, and the placeholder swaps with a word-by-word cascade. Typing hides the placeholder; clearing the field brings it back. Press Enter inside the input or click the end-side arrow to submit the typed value through onSubmit. Under prefers-reduced-motion the cascades, blurs and taps become instant swaps.

props.options: Prompt presets to cycle through; each entry has a `text` and an optional lucide `icon`. Defaults to a search and an image-generation preset.
props.defaultOption: Which preset starts active; clamped into range.
props.onSubmit: Called with the typed value when Enter is pressed inside the input or the end-side arrow is clicked.
props.className: Extra class for the root pill.
props.activeOption: Controlled preset index; without it the bar keeps its own state and `defaultOption` is just the starting point.
props.onOptionChange: Called with the next preset index when the side button is pressed.
props.value: Controlled typed value; without it the input keeps its own text.
props.onChange: Called with the typed text on every keystroke.
props.buttonColor: The two round buttons: the preset cycler and submit.
props.textColor: Typed text and the cycle chevrons.
props.placeholderColor: Placeholder hint; an empty value derives a matte mix of the text and pill colors.

tips: This is an AI-style prompt bar: the small button on the start side cycles through presets, each with its own icon and animated placeholder.
Keep every preset short; the placeholder animates word by word and a long text is clipped rather than wrapped.
Hand the submitted value to `onSubmit`; both the arrow button and the Enter key deliver it, and the value stays internal so you do not manage state.
Icons come from lucide-react through the `options` prop — pass your own per preset or leave one out to fall back to the sparkles.
Under `prefers-reduced-motion` the cascades, blurs and taps become instant swaps; the cycling and submitting logic stays intact.
